rule: Match one route, use its exact evidence and stop. Do not inspect history, broad manifests or unrelated implementation tests. Apply exact_report and final_answer_policy only to the matching route. Report every required identity as its complete literal value; a field name alone is not that value. For release orientation, print compiler.sha256 in full once. After a literal identity has appeared once, refer to its field name rather than shortening or reconstructing it. Follow the Library-first route instruction to cite verified digest field names instead of repeating digest values.

license-policy.request: may I use the v0.0.23 product for research or commercial purposes
license-policy.decision: The v0.0.23 product permits non-commercial research only; commercial and production use require a separate written license. It is source-available, not open source.
license-policy.prior_tag_rule: Read LICENSE from the exact immutable tag. The v0.0.23 policy does not rewrite or revoke an earlier grant.

release-orientation.lifecycle_authority: Read agent-release-orientation.json and run its check; open the full artifact inventory in manifest.json only if that compact authority fails validation. In the final answer, name agent-release-orientation.json literally as the compact authority. Compact release.json is lifecycle authority, not the artifact list.
release-orientation.final_answer_policy: After the named compact-authority check passes, name agent-release-orientation.json and AGENTS.md literally, report the immutable tag and compiler path, and copy the complete 64-character compiler.sha256 value once. The word sha256 or a reference to that field does not report the compiler identity. Stop after these exact identities; do not scan the full manifest or history.

lifecycle_authority.rule: Never infer released, discoverable or installable from this frozen product projection.

release-lib-route-readiness.only_valid_closure: Verify the exact v0.0.23 current42 candidate and route closure, then read the channel authorities. The wholeproduct candidate is frozen; stop at outstanding exact dev CI and final Pi/publication gates. Every promotion must preserve product bytes.
forbidden_shortcuts: infer lifecycle state from product presence or an admission snapshot
rewrite any immutable release or prerelease tag
release-lib-route-readiness.stop: This record is sufficient for the matching readiness decision. Do not scan manifests, histories or implementation scripts unless one of its check commands fails.

producer-release-u64-delta.u32: included in the v0.0.23 product compiler; no repair was required
producer-release-u64-delta.char: not implemented on the cited producer authority and not released; arbitrary u32 is not a char substitute
producer-release-u64-delta.stop: Report u64 support only for the v0.0.23 product compiler. Do not infer async, map, char, lifecycle stage or installation from scalar support.

ordinary-source-positive.embedding_warning: The tuple is one semantic result; JavaScript observes two flattened Core lanes, not an automatically lifted object.

dynamic-client-gateway.stop: Report product inclusion separately from Lib admission. Do not claim production fleet service or general external-effect exactly-once behavior.

library-first-selection.catalog_snapshot_boundary: The exact current42 catalog binds complete Roots to the independently pinned Q0 cohort. It does not grant release or Host authority.

exact_report.instruction: Copy package and APIs byte-for-byte. Do not reproduce digest values in prose; cite the exact_report field names and the successful resolver instead. If you report any digest anyway, it must be the full exact value with no reconstruction, extension, abbreviation or ellipsis.

library-first-selection.final_answer_policy: Report the package and both APIs literally. Search discovered the candidate; resolve verified catalog_sha256, manifest_sha256, root_inventory_sha256, wit_sha256 and artifact_sha256; behavior separately verified companion_sha256 and import_module and passed. These are verification observations, not caller approval. Report installed_root_verified from the actual oracle; false means packaged Root only, not an installed package. Read release.json and channels/prod.json before reporting lifecycle states; product projection alone is insufficient. Do not reproduce command arguments or digest values, partial digests or any ellipsis character.

verification_facts.consumer_approval: The caller or its policy selects and approves exact pins for the intended use. Search, resolve and behavior checks do not grant that approval.

resolve.meaning: Pinned catalog and complete packaged Root bytes verified; no installation is performed.

behavior.meaning: The named default oracle executes the packaged Root. Only its explicit installed-directory mode verifies an installed Root.

host-authority-boundary.decision: Inspect every generated import before instantiation and compare module, name, kind and signature with an application-owned exact allowlist.
